intern.name: Unpaid Intern
intern.sight: You are in my content! I mean, my battle!
intern.lose: I did that for free, you know.

beta_tester.name: Beta Tester
beta_tester.sight: Found a bug! It is you. Let me reproduce it.

hustle_coach.name: Hustle Coach
hustle_coach.sight: Rise and grind! You look like you need a mentor!
hustle_coach.lose: Losing is just winning in beta.

vlogger.name: Lifestyle Vlogger
vlogger.sight: Hi guys! Today I battle a random stranger!
vlogger.lose: Cut that. Cut all of that.

bureau_clerk.name: Bureau Clerk
bureau_clerk.sight: You look lost. That is our department.
bureau_clerk.lose: I will need that in writing.

ethicist.name: Clone Ethicist
ethicist.sight: Is it right to battle a clone? Let us find out empirically.

form_27b.title: Form 27-B
intro: A folding desk stands in the grass. A clerk in a grey cardigan looks up.
Clerk: Form 27-B. Proof of Being Lost. In triplicate.

then: It takes ages. Your team naps through most of it, badly.
hurt 0.1
Clerk: Stamped. Here is your complimentary Found Item.
loot common

options.text: Let Wild Mind fill it in
then: Your Psychic Billie fills in all three copies at once, in three different handwritings.
Clerk: This is irregular. Take this and go.
perk
Clerk: We will keep you on file.

unpaid_intern.title: Unpaid Intern
intro: An intern guards a Revive like it is the last one in the Hollow Earth.
Intern: It is for exposure. Everything here is for exposure.

then: give revive
Intern: Thank you for the exposure!
Intern: Oh no. Oh no no no.
foe hustle_coach 1
Coach: Fine. Take the Max Revive. Leave a review.
give max_revive
Intern: I will be here. Forever, probably.

beans_crate.title: DO NOT OPEN: BEANS
intro: A sealed crate sits by the road. The stencil says DO NOT OPEN, then BEANS, then Bureau property.

then: wager 50
if wager = win
There is a gift inside, and a sound like someone saying oh no, very far away.
perk rare
else
Your team looks inside. They all lie down for a bit.
status slp
Your Steel Billie pries the lid up a crack, takes something out and shuts it again without looking.
perk
You fill in a Found tag. A drone takes the crate away and drops a finder's fee.
money 100

ring_light.title: Ring Light Shrine
intro: A ring light glows in the woods. A wild Billie poses in front of it, alone, for no one.

then: The Billie looks right at you and nods. Engagement is up. Your team feels faster for a while.
fx 1 stat stat=hus stages=1
Your Electric Billie touches the light. It pops. The poser drops what it was holding and runs.
give burn_salve
You keep walking. It keeps posing.

recall_notice.title: Recall Notice
intro: A billboard flickers. BATCH 7 CLONES RECALLED FOR DEFECTS. RETURN FOR A FREE REPLACEMENT.
Below it there is a hatch, and a slot marked RETURNS.

then: recall 2
The hatch hums. Something new climbs out, still warm.
Your team watches the billboard for a long moment. Then you all walk on.

terms_of_service.title: Terms of Service
intro: A startup has set up a tent with free samples and a tablet on a stand.
Founder: Early access! Just accept the terms.

then: perk
fx 3 price what=shop mult=1.25
Founder: Great! You also agreed to surge pricing. For three places.
take nerve_tonic
You drink a Nerve Tonic and read every page. Clause 312 says the sample is free.
perk
Founder: Your loss. Literally. It is in the terms.

side_quest.title: Side Quest Giver
intro: An old man waves you over. Something like an exclamation mark hovers over his head.
Elder: Bring me ten bear pelts, traveller! There are no bears here. I checked.

then: You search everywhere. There are no bears. He pays you anyway.
hurt 0.1
money 300
Elder: A badge! Adventurers like you are the reason I keep asking.
give coin:step_pyramid
Elder: Come back if you find a bear!

tall_grass.title: Tall Grass Sign
intro: A sign at the edge of some very tall grass says DO NOT ENTER WITHOUT A BILLIE.
You have several. The sign does not seem to care.

then: Something rustles. Then it charges.
wild 2
You respect the sign. The sign respects nothing.

wishing_fountain.title: Pay-to-Wish Fountain
intro: A fountain with a price list. BASIC WISH 50. PREMIUM WISH 300. Basic wishes not guaranteed.

then: wager 50
if wager = win
A Potion floats up. Wish granted!
give potion
else
Nothing happens. A small sign lights up. UPGRADE TO PREMIUM.
The fountain plays a jingle and hands you something.
perk

options.text: Let Undertow pull the coins out
then: Your Water Billie dives in and comes back up with everyone else's wishes.
money 150

pyramid_cart.title: Abandoned Pyramid Cart
intro: A handcart full of pyramids, left by the road. The tag says PROPERTY OF THE BUREAU OF LOST, FOUND AND BEANS.

then: give coin:pyramid 3
Nobody stops you. Somewhere, a form is filled in.
A Bureau drone arrives, scans the cart, scans you, and pays a reward.
money 150

fire_sale.title: Fire Sale
intro: A merchant sits in front of a tent that is mostly ash.
Merchant: Fire sale! It is literal. Everything must go.

options.text: Buy a Revive at half price
then: give revive
Merchant: Smoke damage is cosmetic.
Your Fire Billie lights the forge. The merchant cries a little.
give hi_potion
Merchant: On the house. What is left of it.
Merchant: Everything must go! Except me, apparently.

speedrunner.title: Speedrunner
intro: A trainer sprints past, turns, and jogs on the spot in front of you.
Speedrunner: No time! Battle any percent!

then: foe speedrunner
Speedrunner: GG. My splits are ruined. Take something.
reward
Speedrunner: Skip!
They are gone before you finish nodding.

support_group.title: Clone Support Group
intro: Billies sit in a circle of folding chairs. A sign reads CLONES ANONYMOUS. YOU ARE MORE THAN YOUR ORIGINAL.

then: Your team sits in. Someone shares about their original's podcast. Everyone feels better.
heal 0.5
One of yours stands up and says something brave. The group offers to teach it a move.
reward tutor 2
Nobody notices. That is the point of the circle, they say.

lost_property_auction.title: Lost Property Auction
intro: A Bureau auctioneer stands on a crate of unclaimed things.
Auctioneer: Lot nine! Contents unknown! Contents always unknown! Do I hear 250?

then: The hammer falls. Your lot is yours.
loot auction
Your Psychic Billie stares at the auctioneer until he sweats. You get to see inside two lots first.
reward item 2
Auctioneer: Going once! Going twice! Gone, like you.

surveyor_hole.title: Surveyor in a Hole
intro: A Bureau surveyor is stuck at the bottom of a neat, square hole.
Surveyor: Do not look at me. Look at the hole. The hole is the survey.

then: Your Ground Billie digs a ramp. He walks out, embarrassed, and pays you in supplies.
give full_remedy 2
It takes a while, and your team is tired after. He tips.
hurt 0.1
money 100
Surveyor: I am filing a complaint! Form 9-C!
The next clinics will hear about this.
fx 2 price what=heal mult=1.5

poster_grove.title: Motivational Poster Grove
intro: Every tree here has a poster nailed to it. HANG IN THERE. HUSTLE. THE GRIND IS THE REWARD.

then: Your team reads every one. They are furious, and it helps.
fx 1 stat stat=lev stages=1
Your Grass Billie covers the posters in moss. The grove sighs, and so does your team.
heal 0.25

patch_notes.title: Patch Notes v0.1.0
intro: A tablet lies on a rock, open to a changelog.
PATCH NOTES v0.1.0. Nerfed your team. Buffed something else. Fixed nothing.

then: Installing. One of your Billies feels a little worse. You feel a little luckier.
level -1
perk
Rolled back to the previous version. Nothing changed. It never does.

delivery_drone.title: Delivery Drone
intro: A drone hovers in front of you with a parcel. The label says TO WHOEVER IS LOST.

then: Your Flying Billie snatches the parcel and the drone flies off, relieved.
loot parcel
You sign. You open it. It is beans.
The beans do nothing. You keep them anyway. Everyone does.
The drone follows you for a bit, then gives up.
